📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Comprehensive audit-fix release for `sendfn` SDKs across TypeScript and Python, introducing production-readiness baseline including typed errors with stable codes, lazy optional-dependency loading, SNS webhook signature verification, deterministic email templating, suppression normalization, push concurrency limiting, device lifecycle helpers, bulk operations with bounded concurrency, release-gate verification, and extensive test coverage plus specification documentation across seven implementation phases. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Configuration & Ignores**
`.gitignore`, `sendfn/typescript/package.json`, `sendfn/typescript/tsconfig.json`, `sendfn/typescript/vitest.config.ts`, `sendfn/python/pyproject.toml`|Added Python artifact ignoring; updated TypeScript package name from `@sendfn/core` to `sendfn`; added `release:verify` npm script; configured path aliases for `@superfunctions/db` and `@superfunctions/http` in both TypeScript build and test configs; added Python release-gate metadata and dependency updates (`email-validator`, pinned `superfunctions`).| |**Audit Specification Documents**
`sendfn/.conduct/audits/*`, `sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/{INTENT_AUDIT,PLAN,REQUIREMENTS,SPEC,TEST_VECTORS}.md`, `sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/phases/{PHASE_00..PHASE_07}.md`|Formal audit report documenting findings, intent coverage matrix, and 20+ named test vectors; comprehensive specification defining packaging, API parity, deterministic templating, email orchestration, webhook verification, push concurrency, device lifecycle, suppression normalization, performance gates, observability redaction, and test/documentation requirements across both SDKs.| |**Phase Reports & Artifacts**
`sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/{phase-reports,phase-artifacts}/*`|Seven phase completion reports documenting implementation status, test results, and acceptance evidence; phase-artifact manual test vectors validating database queries, webhook processing, push/email concurrency, release gates, and documentation drift checks.| |**Python Core Errors & Concurrency**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/errors.py`, `sendfn/python/sendfn/_concurrency.py`|Implemented `SendfnError` with stable `code`/`retryable`/`details` fields and subclasses (`EmailProviderError`, `PushProviderError`, `SmsProviderError`, `SuppressionError`, `TemplateError`, `DatabaseError`, `ValidationError`); added `resolve_concurrency` and `map_with_concurrency` for bounded async fan-out.| |**Python Client & Initialization**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/__init__.py`, `sendfn/python/sendfn/client.py`, `sendfn/python/sendfn/models.py`|Conditional Python-core bootstrap via `superfunctions.db` import fallback; removed eager optional imports (push, SMS, HTTP) from top-level; added `_coerce_error` helper for typed error conversion; wired `bulk_concurrency` into `PushService`; added public methods `refresh_device_token`, `cleanup_inactive_devices`, `query_events`, `bulk_add_to_suppression_list`, `export_suppression_list`, `close()`; added `bulk_concurrency` and email validation to `SendfnOptions`/`SendfnConfig`; added `SuppressionList.email` normalization validator.| |**Python Database & Query Helpers**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/database/{__init__,helpers,memory}.py`|Added `get_email_transaction_by_provider_message_id`, `normalize_suppression_email`, `find_inactive_device_tokens`, `delete_device_tokens` helpers; enhanced `find_events` with provider/time-window filters and deterministic orphan references; added input validation (time-window ordering, limit/offset bounds); implemented email suppression normalization (trim + lowercase); updated memory adapter to enforce unique `id` constraints with `SENDFN_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT` error and fix pagination/filtering semantics.| |**Python Email Service & AWS SES**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/email/{service,aws_ses,templates}.py`|Refactored `send_email` with structured validation (suppression checks, template resolution, provider limits) and bounded retry behavior; added `get_email_status` wrapper; refactored `send_bulk_email` to use bounded concurrency; enhanced template engine to parse nested blocks (`#if`, `#each`), validate for errors, and support dotted variable paths; updated AWS SES error mapping with `_error_code` helper; added `DEFAULT_MAX_RECIPIENTS` and `DEFAULT_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES` constants.| |**Python Webhook & SNS Verification**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/events/{aws_sns_verifier,webhook_handler,tracker}.py`|Implemented `AwsSnsVerifier` for SNS envelope validation (required fields, type checking, certificate HTTPS/hostname validation, timestamp age validation, RSA-SHA1 signature verification) with pre-mutation rejection; updated `AwsSesWebhookHandler` to return structured `{ accepted, verified, matchedTransactions, createdSuppressionEntries }` and apply idempotent lifecycle transitions; added orphan-event deterministic reference IDs; removed event-tracker injection; extended `EventTracker.query_events` with `provider_message_id`, `provider`, `user_id`, `start_at`, `end_at` filters.| |**Python Suppression & Push Services**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/{suppression/manager,push/{apns,fcm,device_manager,service}}.py`|Implemented email normalization in suppression operations; added `bulk_add_to_suppression_list` with duplicate-detection and `export_suppression_list`; updated FCM to batch 500 tokens and aggregate results; updated APNS to use `map_with_concurrency` with cap 10; added device token `refresh_device_token` and `cleanup_inactive_devices` helpers; fixed device timestamp from `datetime.now()` to `datetime.utcnow()` and field mapping (camelCase persistence keys); refactored push service to produce deterministic logical notifications with aggregated counts and stable platform ordering.| |**Python HTTP Routes & Router**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/http/{__init__,fastapi,routes}.py`|Added lazy `__getattr__` for `create_sendfn_router` import; updated FastAPI module to raise `SendfnError` with `SENDFN_OPTIONAL_DEPENDENCY_MISSING` on missing optional dependency; refactored routes to use centralized `execute(...)` wrapper with request-scoped request ID, canonical JSON envelopes (`ok/data/error/meta`), and HTTP status mapping (`401` unauthorized, `400` validation/webhook errors, `500` internal); updated webhook handler key from `"aws_ses"` to `"awsSes"`.| |**Python Push Lazy Imports**
`sendfn/python/sendfn/push/__init__.py`|Removed eager imports of `ApnsProvider` and `FcmProvider`; added module-level `__getattr__` for lazy loading on attribute access.| |**Python README & Examples**
`sendfn/python/{README,examples/{basic_email,suppression,templates}}.py`|Updated README with FastAPI extras, repo-root verification instructions, webhook signature verification note, and examples section; renamed local `sendfn` variable to `client` in all examples; added installation/usage documentation to example docstrings.| |**Python Test Infrastructure & Imports**
`sendfn/python/tests/{conftest,test_imports,test_memory_adapter}.py`|Added shared pytest fixtures (`repo_root`, `python_readme_text`, `python_pyproject_text`, `block_imports`); added import baseline tests validating base package version and optional fastapi extra dependency gating.| |**Python Service & Contract Tests**
`sendfn/python/tests/{test_email_service,test_database_helpers,test_templates,test_push}.py`|Added regression tests for email service (suppression short-circuiting, template/validation errors, provider limits, bounded retry, exhaustion codes); database contract tests (provider-message lookup, event filtering with time windows, pagination limits, suppression normalization, duplicate handling); template engine tests (nested blocks, escaping, malformed-block errors); push tests (FCM chunking, APNS concurrency cap, device refresh, inactive cleanup, bulk concurrency).| |**Python Webhook & Route Tests**
`sendfn/python/tests/{test_webhook_handler,test_http_routes,test_public_api}.py`|Added webhook handler tests (SNS verification rejection, signature/host/timestamp validation, delivery/bounce/complaint idempotency, orphan events, redaction); HTTP route tests (webhook and admin email endpoints with canonical envelopes, auth failures); public API tests (lifecycle methods, error handling, idempotent close, device refresh/cleanup, suppression bulk/export, webhook handler registration).| |**Python Release Gate Tests**
`sendfn/python/tests/test_release_gate.py`|Added release-gate validation asserting repo-root README/pyproject include correct install/test commands, Python version constraints, and `[tool.sendfn.release_gate]` metadata; helper function to detect stable missing-tooling errors.| |**TypeScript Core Errors & Types**
`sendfn/typescript/src/{errors,types}.ts`|Implemented `SendfnError` with `code`/`retryable`/`details`/`cause` fields; added subclasses with defaults (`EmailProviderError`, `PushProviderError`, `SmsProviderError`); added `SendfnClient` interface defining all public methods; added `QueryEventsParams`, `SuppressionCheckResult`, `AddSuppressionParams` types; extended `SendfnOptions` with `bulkConcurrency`; added `SendfnErrorDetails` type.| |**TypeScript Database & Queries**
`sendfn/typescript/src/database/sendfn-db.ts`|Extended `FindEmailParams` and `FindEventParams` with `providerMessageId`, `provider`, `userId`, `startAt`, `endAt`; implemented `getEmailTransactionByProviderMessageId`, `findDeviceTokens`, and `close()` methods; added event query validation (limit clamping, offset validation, time-window ordering); implemented email suppression normalization; added reference-based post-filtering for events.| |**TypeScript Email Service & Templating**
`sendfn/typescript/src/{email,templates}/*`|Refactored `EmailService.sendEmail` with structured validation pipeline and bounded retry behavior; added `sendBulkEmail` with concurrency control; refactored `TemplateEngine` from regex to AST-based parsing supporting nested blocks, explicit error codes, and dotted variable paths; added support for `optionalVariables` in metadata; updated default templates to conditionally render optional fields; enhanced AWS SES adapter with stable error codes.| |**TypeScript Push Service & Providers**
`sendfn/typescript/src/push/{service,fcm,apns,device-manager}.ts`|Refactored `sendPush` to produce deterministic logical notifications with aggregated counts and stable platform ordering; added `sendBulkPush` with bounded concurrency; implemented FCM 500-token batching and APNS concurrency limiting (cap 10 via `mapWithConcurrency`); added device token `refreshDeviceToken` and `cleanupInactiveDevices` helpers; updated `PushService.__init__` to accept `bulk_concurrency` parameter.| |**TypeScript Webhook & Verification**
`sendfn/typescript/src/events/{aws-sns-verifier,webhook-handler,tracker}.ts`|Implemented `AwsSnsVerifier` for SNS envelope validation (certificate fetching, HTTPS/hostname validation, timestamp replay protection, RSA-SHA1 signature verification); refactored `AwsSesWebhookHandler` to return structured `WebhookProcessResult`; added idempotent lifecycle transitions with `applyLifecycleTransition`; added orphan-event deterministic reference IDs; implemented suppression creation for bounce/complaint; extended `EventTracker.queryEvents` to accept `QueryEventsParams | FindEventParams`.| |**TypeScript Utilities & Concurrency**
`sendfn/typescript/src/utils/concurrency.ts`|Added `resolveConcurrency` and `mapWithConcurrency` utilities for bounded async fan-out with ordered results.| |**TypeScript Client & Router**
`sendfn/typescript/src/{sendfn,suppression/manager}.ts`|Implemented `Sendfn implements SendfnClient` with new public methods (`refreshDeviceToken`, `cleanupInactiveDevices`, `bulkAddToSuppressionList`, `exportSuppressionList`, `queryEvents`, `close`); added request envelope/response utilities for API router; refactored admin routes with centralized error mapping and HTTP status logic; added `POST /webhooks/aws-ses` endpoint with request ID tracking; updated `SuppressionManager` with email normalization and bulk/export operations; removed eager optional imports; added provider instance tracking.| |**TypeScript README & Examples**
`sendfn/typescript/{README,examples/{basic-email,custom-templates,event-handling,push-notification}}.ts`|Updated README with adapter examples, repo-root verification, webhook requirements, and examples section; added four new example files demonstrating email sending, templates, push notifications, and event handling with webhook setup.| |**TypeScript Test Doubles & Helpers**
`sendfn/typescript/tests/mock-adapter.ts`|Implemented `StrongMockAdapter` enforcing unique `id` constraints with `SENDFN_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT` errors; `WeakOverwriteMockAdapter` overwriting duplicates (for negative testing); added `assertTestDoubleFidelity` helper validating adapter behavior.| |**TypeScript Import & Release Gate Tests**
`sendfn/typescript/tests/{imports,release_gate}.ts`|Added import baseline tests (package name alignment, public surface checks, absence of `@sendfn/core`); release-gate tests (manifest/README alignment, TypeScript build/lint/test scripts, stable missing-tooling error reporting, test-double fidelity validation).| |**TypeScript Email & Suppression Tests**
`sendfn/typescript/tests/{email,database_contract}.ts`|Added email service regression tests (suppression short-circuiting, template/validation errors, provider limits, bounded retry); database contract tests (provider-message lookup, event filtering with time windows, pagination, suppression normalization, fidelity validation).| |**TypeScript Push & Public API Tests**
`sendfn/typescript/tests/{push,public_api}.ts`|Added push tests (FCM chunking, APNS concurrency cap, device refresh/cleanup, bulk concurrency, provider deactivation); public API tests (method availability, device helpers, suppression bulk/export, webhook handlers, typed errors, idempotent close).| |**TypeScript Template & Webhook Tests**
`sendfn/typescript/tests/{templates,webhook,admin_api}.ts`|Added template engine tests (nested blocks, escaping, malformed-block errors); webhook tests (SNS verification failure, signature/timestamp/envelope validation, delivery/bounce/complaint idempotency, orphan events, redaction); admin API tests (canonical envelopes, auth failures, status codes).| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~60 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 *Hops and commits across the land,* > *From TypeScript peaks to Python sand,* > *Webhooks verified, templates parsed with care,* > *Concurrency bounded everywhere!* > *Two SDKs unified, production-ready, fair—* > *Sendfn's audit complete beyond compare!*

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
